gloss: length and breadth; vertically and horizontally; freely in all directions
notes:
Has two distinct uses: literal (dimensions, grid layout) and figurative (freely, without restriction). The figurative sense, especially with に, is common in writing about sports, intellectual ability, and creative work. Also read たてよこ in some contexts, but じゅうおう is the standard reading for the figurative sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦横|じゅうおう}に{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る: to run around freely in all directions
- {縦横|じゅうおう}に{活躍|かつやく}する: to play an active role in every area
- {縦横|じゅうおう}{無尽|むじん}: inexhaustibly in every direction (four-character compound)
- {縦横|じゅうおう}に{発揮|はっき}する: to demonstrate fully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}: freely, at will — emphasizes effortless mastery
- {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}: in all directions without limit — stronger four-character form of the figurative sense

definitions.explanation: the vertical and horizontal dimensions; length and width
freely and without restriction; in every direction; to one's heart's content

examples.japanese: {縦横|じゅうおう}{十|じゅう}メートルの{部屋|へや}だ。
examples.english: It's a room ten meters by ten meters.

examples.japanese: {道路|どうろ}が{縦横|じゅうおう}に{走|はし}っている。
{碁盤|ごばん}の{目|め}のように{縦横|じゅうおう}に{整備|せいび}された{街並|まちな}みだ。
examples.english: It's a townscape laid out in a grid like a go board.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}を{縦横|じゅうおう}に{発揮|はっき}する。
{彼|かれ}はピッチを{縦横|じゅうおう}に{駆|か}け{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: He ran all over the pitch.

examples.japanese: {知識|ちしき}を{縦横|じゅうおう}に{駆使|くし}して{問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}した。
examples.english: He solved the problem by making full use of his knowledge.
